title: Growth Product Manager - Website & Conversion
description:
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.
As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a Growth Product Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.
You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.
You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.
🌍 ABOUT PENNYLANE
Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.
Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.
KEY FIGURES AND AMBITION
 - 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane
 - 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform
 - 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities
 - 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch
 - 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe
WHAT YOU’LL DO
You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.
OWN CRO AND EXPERIMENTATION
 - Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows
 - Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions
 - Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights
 - Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance
 - Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes
MANAGE THE WEBSITE CONVERSION ROADMAP
 - Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility
 - Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans
 - Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements
 - Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis
 - Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal
 - Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up
BUILD AND OPTIMIZE PAID LANDING PAGES
 - Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns
 - Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck
 - Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages
 - Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging
 - Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience
OWN MEASUREMENT AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION
 - Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data
 - Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance
 - Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 - Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering
 - Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority
WHAT YOU BRING
 - 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field
 - Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment
 - A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics
 - Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare
 - Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses
 - Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making
 - Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility
 - Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:
 - Write clear briefs for designers and engineers
 - Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders
 - Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences
 - Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams
 - Fluent French and professional English
🛠️ TOOLS AND ENVIRONMENT
You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.
SOME OUR TOOLS INCLUDE
 - Amplitude
 - AB Tasty
 - Analytics and reporting dashboards
 - Website content and landing-page production tools
You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
 - Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization
 - Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance
 - The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages
 - A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program
 - Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design
 - High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization
 - Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact
SUCCESS IN THIS RO

title: Founders Associate
description:
Also searchable as: Chief of Staff
 Business Operations Associate
 Strategy and Operations Associate
 Special Projects
 Original title: Founders Associate
WhyBrilliant is sourcing applicants for this role on behalf of a fast-growing Berlin-based B2B healthtech startup.
The company's identity may stay confidential until first contact.
Atlas, our AI Recruiter, is running this search and will pick the best candidates from Nova's network. The next step is to speak to Nova.
 The Role
 Job Title: Founders Associate
 Location: Berlin, Germany
 Why this role matters
 As we rapidly scale our B2B healthcare SaaS platform, the executive team needs an agile operator who can translate high-level strategy into automated, scalable execution. In this role, you will eliminate operational bottlenecks across finance, tooling, and strategic initiatives to sustain our growth trajectory.
 What You'll Do
 Direct ownership of critical operational, financial, and strategic workflows across the entire company.
 Lead and manage recurring finance and controlling workflows to ensure clear visibility into business performance.
 Build and maintain no-code and low-code process automations using tools like Make and n8n.
 Optimize and run core business tools, including HubSpot CRM and AI-assisted workflows using Claude Code.
 Drive high-impact special strategic projects end-to-end alongside the CEO and Operations Lead.
 Coordinate internal HR, recruiting, and core company administration initiatives.
 Who this is a fit for
 Degree holder from a top-tier university with a strong analytical foundation.
 Experienced in high-growth startups, management consulting, venture building, or VC.
 Pragmatic builder comfortable executing complex projects autonomously in ambiguous environments.
 Skilled in process automation and CRM management (Make, n8n, HubSpot).
 Fluent bilingual communicator in German (C1+) and English (C1+).
 What it's like to work here
 A flat, collaborative environment built on high agency, rapid decision-making, and daily autonomy. Team members actively experiment, take full ownership of end-to-end tasks, and thrive in an agile, hybrid setup based in Berlin. Founders expect proactive problem-solving without micromanagement.
 The offer
 Direct partnership and daily collaboration with our CEO and executive leadership.
 A flat, high-agency environment where you make rapid decisions without micromanagement.
 Complete end-to-end ownership across diverse business functions.
 Agile, hybrid work setup based in the heart of Berlin.
 This probably isn't for you if
 You prefer rigid instructions and predefined processes over figuring out messy problems on your own.
 You want a narrow, specialized role rather than wearing multiple strategic and operational hats.
 You require constant oversight and step-by-step guidance to execute tasks.
 Who are Atlas & Nova?
 I'll go first. I'm Nova, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call — what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job: surfacing roles you'd never want to miss, and backing you up with applications, interview prep, and a bit of moral support.
And I'm Atlas, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand exactly who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Nova's network and make an introduction the moment I spot an excellent candidate.
 How does this work?
 Nova is an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. She works for you.
Atlas is the AI recruiter working for the company. He recruits from Nova's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Nova will keep sending you strong alternatives.
 We never post fake jobs
 This isn't a trick. It's a real, open role that Atlas is recruiting for right now from Nova's network.
Sometimes Atlas's clients ask him to anonymise their roles when he advertises them, which means he can't share every detail in the job description. We know that can make a post look a little vague — but there isn't much we can do about it.
Give Nova a try. You could land this role. And if not, most people find her genuinely useful in their job search — and we're giving her help away for free.
This job is hosted on whybrilliant.com. Use your LinkedIn profile to register on WhyBrilliant.com and apply for the role directly.

title: Senior IT Project Manager Energy Trading (m/f/d)
description:
ENGIE stands for comprehensive expertise in the energy transition, both in Germany and worldwide, providing energy solutions and services ranging from plant engineering to innovative technologies for the future. More than 5,500 employees at 50 locations are already actively driving the energy transition forward today.
How do we do that? We design, build, operate and market solutions in the areas of wind, solar and energy storage. At the same time, we support businesses, industrial companies, municipalities and the housing sector in achieving their sustainability goals with tailored building and energy solutions, including technical facility management services in the areas of HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing and sanitation. And that's only part of what we do. Together, we're shaping the future of energy.
Your tomorrow starts today! Join us in welcoming the future and become part of our success as
 Senior IT Project Manager Energy Trading (m/f/d) 
 Location: Berlin or Cologne
 Reference number: 65001
We are looking for a Senior IT Project Manager with a strong mix of business analysis, project management, and technical expertise to drive digitalisation initiatives in the energy trading environment.
In this role, you will work closely with trading desks, business teams, operations, IT, and external partners. You thrive in complex, multi-stakeholder setups, enjoy translating business challenges into pragmatic technical solutions, and feel comfortable navigating changing requirements and constraints.
Experience in the energy sector, particularly in supply, flexibility (FLEX) and battery energy storage systems (BESS), is a strong advantage.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Stakeholder Interaction & Cross-Functional Coordination 
 Manage digitalization projects in energy trading between different stakeholders (local and global) with an end2end process mindset, including documentation, reporting and communication 
 Transfer business challenge into functional and technical requirements, evaluate internal and external options and design end2end realistic, technically feasible solutions 
 Bridge the gap between business and IT by acting as a technical sparring partner for both sides 
 Technical Implementation & Integration Work 
 Lead projects through the development or implementation phase, ensure proper testing, secure Go Lives and handover to operations 
 Interact with energy market data, schedules, consumption time series, asset data or settlement processes 
 Combine project management with hands-on execution: Implement and use smaller Python-based ETL and integration logic independently, and use Azure components such as API Management, Application Insights, and Key Vault for secure and observable integrations 
 Perform structured testing, Go Lives, Hypercare and Handover to operations 
 Your profile: 
 >5 years of experience in IT project management, IT consulting or data engineering and integration, ideally in the energy sector with a strong technical affinity 
 Experience with user stories, process modeling (BPMN), and concept creation 
 Strong communication on all hierarchy levels and senior project management skills, especially in multi-stakeholder environments 
 Pragmatic coding skills: Solid Python/SQL knowledge, to independently solve smaller technical challenges or build prototypes, experience with REST APIs, SFTP, script-based automation, GitHub workflows 
 Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or comparable project management tools 
 Practical experience with Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe is a plus 
 The openness to being on call on the weekend every 4-6th week will be a plus 
 English fluency, German is an advantage 
 What We Offer You: 
 RECHARGE YOUR BATTERY: Those who power through also need to recharge their batteries! That's why moments of relaxation together are particularly important to us - for example at the summer party or on a ski trip 
 FUTURE? SECURED! We also look ahead when planning your life. With subsidies for company pension schemes and special offers for occupational disability insurance. 
 ELECTRISING EXTRAS: Whether e-bikes, electronic hardware or discounts - when browsing the ENGIE platform for our employees, there are plenty of products, services and price advantages from well-known (online) shops to discover. 
 COMBINING FAMILY AND WORK: At ENGIE, we are moving towards the future together. We create more room for manoeuvre for you by supporting your family with a subsidy of up to €150.00 for daycare or kindergarten fees. 
 ON AND OFF AS NEEDED: Switch off when it suits you. Our flexible project work gives you plenty of freedom to organise your working hours.
 We Embrace Diversity 
 At ENGIE, we are convinced that every talent plays an important role in accelerating the energy transition. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible work environment where diversity is valued and each individual is supported.
Our goal is to create a culture of collaboration and innovation where every employee can thrive and reach their full potential.
We actively welcome applications that contribute to the diversity of our company. Every talent is welcome here—and, above all, valued equally! Regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or disability.
 HELLO TOMORROW! 
 Your tomorrow starts today! Become part of our success with excellent career prospects and high recognition. Join us in shaping the future of energy. We look forward to receiving your online application.
 Your contact: 
 Stefanie Holscher Blackman
Talent Acquisition Partner
